###### – Erika Evans

![](https://electerikaevans.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Shaun-Scott-300x300.jpg)

> Erika Evans would make a great City Attorney because she’s demonstrated her values and grit by building the coalition that we’ll need to defeat a Republican City Attorney. In the age of Trump and corporate oligarchy, working-class leaders like Erika are doing important work to make Seattle a truly progressive city by standing for 911 alternatives, law enforcement-assisted diversion, and pro-worker policies that crack down on wage theft and bad bosses. In a field of very talented candidates, Erika stands out, and I’m proud to support her.
>
> **State Rep. Shaun Scott (43rd LD)**

![](https://electerikaevans.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Julia-Reed-300x300.jpg)

> "Seattle needs an active and engaged City Attorney who shares our values and steps up to fight for our city—not a Republican who hesitates to speak out against the Trump administration. We need Erika as our City Attorney."
>
> **State Rep. Julia Reed (36th LD)**

![](https://electerikaevans.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/IMG_1956-300x300.jpeg)

> “Erika Evans has the perfect experience, skills and commitment to resist the federal assaults on civil rights and free speech. She will use evidence-based practices that actually reduce crime and recidivism rather than just filling up the jail, while not adding to existing racial disparities.”
>
> **King County Superior Court Hon. Theresa Doyle (Ret.)**

![](https://electerikaevans.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Teresa20Mosqueda20by20Kariba20Photography-1-300x300.jpeg)

> I’m proud to endorse Erika, as a dedicated public servant who has stood up to the Trump administration and will fight for Seattle as our City Attorney. She has the support of MLK Labor and working families in our city!
>
> **King County Councilmember Teresa Mosqueda**

![](https://electerikaevans.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/IMG_6149-300x300.jpeg)

> Justice can’t stop at the courthouse doors—it must reach every corner of our city, including our ports of entry. We need a city attorney who will fight for civil rights, uphold human dignity, and partner with others to keep our region a place of inclusion, safety, and opportunity for all. Erika Evans has been and will continue to be that leader, and she deserves our vote for city attorney
>
> **Port of Seattle Commissioner Toshiko Grace Hasegawa**

![](https://electerikaevans.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Patty-Kuderer.jpeg-300x300.jpg)

> Erika Evans is exactly the kind of local leader we need to protect health care access and defend individual rights under threat from Trump’s attacks—and Ann Davison’s inaction. As Seattle City Attorney, she will be a strong, experienced partner, and she has earned our vote.
>
> **Insurance Commissioner of Washington Patty Kuderer**

![](https://electerikaevans.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/SEIU-925-300x300.png)

> When Trump is attacking immigrants and progressive cities, we need a City Attorney who will stand up to his attacks and use evidence-based approaches, and that’s Erika Evans. Ann Davison’s embrace of failed policies, abandonment of community court and restorative justice, and failure of leadership demand urgent change.

![](https://electerikaevans.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Nick-Brown-011_Crop-300x300.jpg)

> “Erika Evans will ensure that the Seattle City Attorney is a partner in our efforts to safeguard the rights and safety of all Washingtonians-- especially as we combat Trump overreach. She has unmatched experience in criminal and civil law as an Assistant US Attorney and will be the leader we need in this important office. Erika deserves our vote."
>
> **Washington State Attorney General Nick Brown**

![](https://electerikaevans.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/2020-Headshot-2-300x300.jpg)

> With Trump escalating attacks on our laws and rights, it is critical that we elect Erika Evans as Seattle City Attorney. Erika is a proven fighter with expertise in both federal and local law, and a clear voice for equity and justice. Please join me in voting for Erika as our next City Attorney.

![](https://electerikaevans.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Girmay-Zahilay-300x300.jpg)

> “Erika will bring the experience and passion we need to address challenges locally, and threats nationally. Her knowledge of the law and commitment to our communities would make her an exceptional City Attorney. Vote for Erika."
>
> **King County Councilmember Girmay Zahilay**

![](https://electerikaevans.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/IMG_5421-300x300.jpeg)

> "As a former federal prosecutor, Erika has demonstrated a deep understanding of the law, the ability to navigate complex legal systems, and a commitment to justice. Her experience is an asset and will allow her to succeed as Seattle City Attorney."
>
> **King County Prosecuting Attorney Leesa Manion**

![](https://electerikaevans.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/DSC_2810-5f13c914-cc626325-417w-300x300.png)

> I'm proud to endorse Erika Evans for Seattle City Attorney. Erika brings the precise experience we need—she has been a civil attorney, pro tem municipal court judge, and a federal prosecutor. 
> Erika will provide the proactive leadership Seattle needs to fight back against the Trump Administration's attacks on immigrants, climate justice, reproductive rights, and our fundamental values. When the Trump Administration sent the National Guard into Los Angeles last weekend, Erika was one of my first calls—and I realized I already trust her expertise to safeguard our city. Seattle deserves a City Attorney who will be a fierce defender of our rights and an advocate for our people. 
> Erika will lead on day one, working alongside our state Attorney General to protect our community while never losing sight of the local issues that matter most. I urge you to join me in supporting Erika Evans to be Seattle’s next City Attorney.
>
> **Seattle City Councilmember Alexis Mercedes Rinck, District 8**

![](https://electerikaevans.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Chipalo-Street--300x300.jpg)

> “Erika's experience as a Federal Prosecutor is a unique qualification at a time when we need a City Attorney who knows federal law—and can stand up for our safety and rights."
>
